observations: White or cream upholstered sofa with a curved backrest
Vertical channel stitching on the seat cushions
Watermark text "KENNY PETERS" across the center of the image
Metal frame or stand visible on the right edge
Green plant leaves at the bottom edge

claims.evidence: Photos show appearance but cannot reveal how long the item has been used
No measuring tape or reference object for scale in the photo

risks.risk: Hidden frame or spring damage underneath
risks.proof: Video of someone sitting on it or lifting it to show the underside

risks.risk: Stains, odors, or pet damage not visible from this angle
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all cushions, arms, and underside
Photo with a tape measure stretched along the full length

risks.risk: Upholstery is faux leather rather than genuine leather
risks.proof: Close-up texture shot or seller confirmation of material

proof_requests: Tape measure stretched along the full length to confirm over 4 feet
Close-up photos of all seating surfaces, arms, and underside
Video showing the sofa being sat on to test frame and springs
response.reason: The item is clearly a 2 seater sofa and can be priced at its worst case; unproven claims about age and length are treated as false.
